name: Junior Camp Counselor in Training
org: Lower Paxton Township Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Teens help senior counselors run games, crafts and activities for campers. They learn to lead and to watch kids. Each camp takes one Junior Counselor a year.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 15 at the start of camp (June 15 in 2026). Must commit three days a week for at least five weeks. Needs three PA clearances (state police record, child abuse history, FBI fingerprint) and a CPR class.
duration: 3 days a week for 5 to 8 weeks of summer camp
deadline_text: Send a letter of interest by March 15. Selections by April 30. These are from the 2026 camp season.
how_to_apply: Send a Letter of Interest to the Program Manager by March 15. Then get the three clearances and a CPR card. Then go to staff orientation.
notes: Only one spot per camp. Dates are for the 2026 season, so check the page in early 2027.
